name: GAD-AMS Development
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y php8.3-cli php8.3-intl php8.3-gd php8.3-mysql php8.3-curl php8.3-mbstring php8.3-xml php8.3-zip mysql-server && sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/mysql-files /var/run/mysqld && sudo chown -R mysql:mysql /var/lib/mysql /var/lib/mysql-files /var/run/mysqld && sudo chmod 750 /var/lib/mysql-files && sudo usermod -d /var/lib/mysql mysql && sudo ln -sfn /usr /home/codespace/.php/current && composer install --working-dir=backend && npm --prefix public_html install
